subject: encode-cpu: editing render_encoder.inc set*Bytes + generic resource/binding build (intent)
body: Editing now (small, localized): TeguRenderEncoder ivars (+vertexBytesBase/Length, fragmentBytesBase/Length after vertexOffsets), setVertexBuffer/setFragmentBuffer (clear marker), set*BufferOffset (bytes-slot offset relative to its sub-allocation), setVertexBytes/setFragmentBytes (sub-allocate from the existing per-encoder expandArena, 256-aligned, instead of a new BO per call), and in tegu_render_generic_snapshot_rt only the resource loop + GENERIC_BUFFER memory: a bytes slot is shown to the planner exactly as today ({length=len, offset relative}) and its descriptor memory offset becomes base+descriptor_offset. No batching/clear/bridge code touched. Will re-read right before editing.
